Subject: Proposal: Annual upfront incentives & ramp schedule for Streamline AI

Hi Chris —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. As discussed, we put together an initial structure that makes a move from your current monthly billing to an annual upfront commitment attractive while addressing your anticipated ramp in usage over the first 12 months. Attached: pricing_model_v3.xlsx (quarterly ramp scenarios + unit economics).

High-level proposal (summary):
- Term: 12 months, option to extend to 24 months with step-down pricing in year 2
- Commitment: $600k annual commit (billed upfront) — covers estimated steady-state usage of ~1.2B tokens/year
- Discounting: 18% off list for annual upfront versus current monthly list; additional 3% loyalty credit if you extend to 24 months at signing
- Ramp schedule: conservative quarters (Q1 40%, Q2 65%, Q3 95%, Q4 100%) with a usage true-up at month 12 (monthly true-up credit if actual usage < committed)
- Flexible payment alternative: 50% upfront, 50% at month 6 (no change to discount but reduced cash outlay)
- Early termination: pro-rated refund of unused months minus onboarding credit (we can share language for legal)

Questions for you:
1) Do you need a split-payment option or can procurement commit to full upfront?
2) Does the proposed ramp map to your product roadmap (Q2 embed -> Q3 scale)?
3) Any required PO or SOW language we should include for finance/legal?

Next steps: if this looks good, I can circulate a one-page term sheet and a DocuSign envelope for signatures.

Thanks,
Rachel

Thanks Rachel — appreciate the clear outline. A couple of follow-ups from our side:

- The $600k number looks in the ballpark but our CFO is hesitant on full upfront at that level. Would Redwood be open to a 3-way split (40/40/20 over first 3 months) if we commit to 24 months?
- On the ramp: those quarter %s look reasonable but we need a safety net if usage lags (e.g., credits we can use the following year).
- Legal asked us to confirm the termination refund calculation — can you share the exact formula?

Also looping procurement to verify what PO timing looks like. We need to close the commercial terms by end of month to hit our Q2 roadmap.

—Chris

Chris — helpful questions, thanks. Quick answers below and I attached a one-page term sheet (rachel_term_sheet_2026-03-19.pdf) with the exact refund / termination language for legal to review. Key clarifications:

1) Payment flexibility: we can do a 3-way split (40% at signing, 40% at month 3, 20% at month 6) conditional on a 24-month commitment. For that we propose a 20% discount (instead of 18%) in year 1 and the additional 3% loyalty credit applied in year 2. So effectively year-1 net discount is 23% if you sign for 24 months and take the staged payment.

2) Usage lag protection: we offer a one-time carry-forward credit equal to unused committed tokens up to 20% of annual commit to be applied within 12 months following the term. Also a monthly true-up mechanism at month 12 to reconcile actual to committed usage; surplus usage billed at agreed unit rate.

3) Termination refund formula (excerpt from term sheet): pro-rated refund = (Prepaid amount) * (Months remaining / 12) - Onboarding fee ($25k) - Usage overage settlements. Refunds issued within 45 days of termination notice. Legal can request modified language; we’ve used this structure with several enterprise customers.

If procurement needs special PO language, please send the template; we can review and mark up. I’ll also loop Ben for marketing credit options and Jordan for SSO/KMS notes you flagged in the demo.

Next: I will drop DocuSign link once we confirm the payment cadence you prefer.

Best,
Rachel
